parameters.text:
You are a financial data extraction expert. Parse this Indian bank transaction email and return ONLY a valid JSON array. Even if there is only one transaction, wrap it in an array [].

Email: Dear Customer, Your a/c no. XXXX1234 is debited for Rs. 500.00 on 02-Jun-2026 14:30:00 towards UPI/P2A/1234567890/swiggyupi@axisbank/AXIS Bank. Your a/c balance is Rs. 15,230.50. - SBI

Return ONLY JSON array in this exact format:
[{"amount": 500.00, "currency": "INR", "transaction_type": "DEBIT", "merchant_name": "Swiggy", "merchant_upi": "swiggyupi@axisbank", "bank_name": "SBI", "account_last4": "1234", "category": "food", "date": "2026-06-02", "time": "14:30"}]

Rules:
- amount: number only (no Rs/INR/commas)
- merchant_upi: clean UPI ID (swiggyupi@axisbank)
- merchant_name: brand name only (Swiggy)
- If field not found, use null
- Return ONLY the JSON array, no explanation

options.systemMessage: You extract financial transaction data from Indian bank emails. Always return valid JSON array only.
